title: Cycle count shows Not Tracked for an untracked part and never counts it
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-T1) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 5 in {Bin-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-U1) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 3 in {Bin-A}.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CC-), which is typed in the Inventory search.
  • No Cycle count is in progress on the Inventory list.
custom_steps:
1. Click the ⋮ actions menu.
  2. Click Cycle count.
  3. Read the Total Qty and Count cells of both rows.
  4. Type 6 in the Count box of {Part-A}.
  5. Click Save in the toolbar, and confirm if asked.
  6. Read both rows in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: {Part-B}'s Total Qty and Count cells both read "Not Tracked" in grey, and there is no Count box on its row; {Part-A} shows "5 Available" and an empty Count box.
  • Step 6: {Part-A} now shows "6 Available" (counted 6 replaces 5, an adjustment of +1). {Part-B} still shows "Not Tracked" with "{Bin-A} | 3": it was not counted and its bin did not change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S5-R12 and §8 User Feedback Summary (Untracked part in Cycle count), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.7 (Cycle count leaves it out) and tracking-note-6, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R12: “In Cycle count, an untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the count column instead of count boxes, and it is never counted.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Untracked part in Cycle count): “"Not Tracked" | In the count column, in place of the count boxes”
